home.title: Membership
home.intro: FGV's memberships and user accounts. Log in or create an account.

register.title: Create account
register.intro: You will get an email with a link where you confirm your address and choose a password. After that an administrator gives you access to FGV's applications.
register.messageHint: Who are you and what do you want access to?
register.sent: If the address can be used, we have sent a message with a link. The link is valid for 48 hours.

error.challenge: The check that you are not a robot failed. Please try again.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
error.invalid: Check the details and try again.
error.unavailable: The account could not be created right now. Please try again later.

verify.title: Confirm email address
verify.explain: Confirm your email address. You will then get a message where you choose a password.
verify.done: Thank you! Your address is confirmed. You will now get a message where you choose a password. After that an administrator gives you access, and you get a message when it is done.
verify.invalid: The link no longer works. Create the account again if it has expired.

admin.name: Name
admin.applicationsHelp: Pick the highest role. The roles below it are given too, and the roles above it are removed.
admin.inconsistent: The roles in Keycloak do not follow the ladder. Save to repair them.
admin.notify: Send an email to the user about this update
admin.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate the account and log the user out?
admin.sendSetPassword: Send link to choose a password
admin.sendPasswordReset: Send link to reset the password

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to see this page.

membership.title: My membership
membership.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a spexare in the register yet, so there is no membership to show. Contact the board.

pay.title: Pay a membership fee
pay.intro: Pick the fee for each year you want to pay for, or the one-time fee for a life membership.
pay.noFees: No fees are open for payment right now.
pay.keepReference: Keep the reference unchanged in the message. It is how the treasurer finds your payment.
pay.paidBy: Who paid, if it was someone else
pay.reported: Thank you! We will confirm when the treasurer has found your payment.
pay.waitingForConfirmation: Waiting for confirmation: you have said that you paid. You get an email when the treasurer has found the payment.
pay.confirmed: Your payment is confirmed. Thank you!

treasurer.title: Payments
treasurer.intro: Requests that wait for payment. Record a payment when you have seen the money, in the bank or in Swish; the payer gets a receipt and the membership counts.

status.REPORTED: The payer says they have paid

treasurer.confirmCancel: Cancel this request and its memberships?

fees.title: Fees
fees.intro: What a membership costs for a year, or the one-time fee for a life membership. Retired fees are not offered to members but stay on what was paid.

defaults.title: Default access
defaults.intro: The access a new account gets when it is created from a payment made elsewhere, e.g. in the WordPress shop. The highest role you pick on an application comes with the roles below it. Existing accounts are never changed.
